remarks: Discover sophisticated high-rise living on the 14th floor of this prestigious luxury building. This impeccably maintained 2-bedroom, 2-bathroom condominium boasts a desirable western exposure and a fresh, appealing decor throughout. Recent renovations showcase meticulous attention to detail, including a completely renovated secondary bathroom, updated kitchen enhancements, elegant crown moldings, custom window treatments and stylish new wall sconces and ceiling lighting plus 3 newer heat/AC units create a move-in ready environment. This gently used residence has been a part-time retreat, occupied only three months annually, ensuring exceptional condition and care. The thoughtful floor plan maximizes space and natural light from the western exposure and its 3 season terrace. A storage locker on the lower level and two deeded parking spaces (#84 and #85) on Level G2 provide ultimate convenience. Resort-style building amenities include 24-hour front desk security, an in ground heated pool with expansive decking for relaxation, two well-equipped fitness rooms, and a well-stocked library. This turnkey opportunity offers the perfect blend of luxury, convenience, and lifestyle in a full-service building steps from the heart of downtown Stamford.
